node.title: Re: Question about base64 encoded attributes with Net::LDAP::LDIF
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
with that attribute encrypted

Note that Base64 is not encryption, it is just obfuscation. To anyone who knows what Base64 is, reading the userPassword attribute will be no problem at all whether it's encoded or not.

Anyway, the [mod://Net::LDAP::LDIF] constructor mentions a encode => 'base64' parameter, have you tried that? It's always best if you show some short but representative code - see [id://1177642|SSCCE].
